# NBC News

> > NBC News is a leading digital news platform providing breaking news, investigative journalism, and consumer shopping guidance through NBC Select.

NBC News delivers comprehensive news coverage alongside NBC Select, a dedicated shopping hub offering expert product reviews, deals, and gift recommendations across categories like beauty, technology, kitchen, and home goods. The platform is part of the NBCUniversal family of brands.

## Key Topics

- NBC News
- NBC Select
- NBCUniversal
- Product reviews
- Shopping deals
- Consumer guidance
- Beauty products
- Technology
- Home goods
- Kitchen essentials
- Privacy preferences
- Account management
- Personalized advertising
- Data privacy

## Shopping & Product Reviews

- [Select | Deals, Tips and Product Reviews | Select | NBC News](https://shop.nbcnews.com/): NBC Select shopping hub featuring product reviews, deals, and gift ideas

## Account & Privacy Management

- [NBCUniversal Profile](https://id.nbcnews.com/home): NBCUniversal Profile management for account, privacy, and preferences
